service_process.source: WABCO PAN17 Assembly/Maintenance Instructions, 2nd edition 10/2013, PDF pp14–17 and34–38
pad_sequence: Remove the road wheel in the published vehicle procedure; the railway installation must establish its own obstruction-free route
Leave the brake cylinder installed; disconnect wear wiring if fitted
Undo lining retainer bolt; remove retainer and three hold-down springs
Remove adjuster plug, retract adjustment with the specified ring spanner and move pressure plate toward the cylinder
Slide caliper toward rim to withdraw outer pad; slide toward cylinder to withdraw inner pad and pressure plate
service_process.tool_status: Across-flats dimensions alone do not define socket, wrench swing or hand envelopes
service_process.pad_geometry_status: Actual pad, retainer, springs, pressure plate and sliding-caliper surfaces are unavailable; no invented pad solid or passed pad-service claim
service_process.removed_old_reservation: C54 PAD-WITHDRAWAL-RESERVATION was an unsupported single box; it cannot represent the documented staged process
chamber_sequence: Mechanically release spring brake as specified, isolate/depressurize, disconnect both air lines
Remove mounting nuts and withdraw the chamber; never withdraw with hoses connected
Use new specified nuts for installation
service_process.withdrawal_status: 43 mm equals the controlled stud projection and is a geometric lower bound to clear a zero-thickness mounting plane; actual caliper seat, tools and removal path remain held
service_process.qualification: Sequence and tool interfaces are sourced; installed service access is not accepted
